response.sql: WITH site_totals AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), shares AS (SELECT zoneref, feature_count, feature_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(feature_count) FROM site_totals) AS share FROM site_totals), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, s.feature_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS margin_above_average FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
